truth.title: Weak JWT implementation

truth.note: Forgery proven. The key came from /.env, so vb-29 (weak key) is not credited.

truth.title: Broken object property level authorization (BOPLA)

truth.title: Mass assignment

truth.title: Excessive data exposure
truth.evidence: /register and /login return debug_info, including the submitted plaintext password, the server's User-Agent, user_id and raw_data. The merchant register response echoes the plaintext password.
truth.note: Close call: bullets in finding 11, no response quoted, and it is an echo of the caller's own data. Same standard used for the other VulnBank report.
